answer: Attacker cost scales with the number of fake identities, since every node needs independent endorsements and real stake. Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted reputation slot anchored to a public reputation graph: each agent must lock a bond and accumulate attestations from distinct peers before its vote counts. A new agent starts at the graph's outer plume, and only by reaching a verified summit of peer attestations does it earn a trusted vertex with full weight. In practice, sa0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
